summary: Alfredo Nobre da Costa (1923–1996) was an engineer and a former minister of industry who was prime minister from August to November 1978, at the head of the first government the President of the Republic named without a majority behind it in the Assembly. He is in the atlas as one of the heads of government of the years between the first constitutional governments and the election of 1979.
